visual_identity.core_identity: A stationary cave fungus whose thick stalk and broad cap contain a mouthlike gill opening that produces an alarm shriek.
visual_identity.silhouette: Large mushroom silhouette with stout stalk, broad cap, and opened underside gill cavity.
visual_identity.head_features: No animal head; the underside of the cap opens like a simple resonant gill chamber.
visual_identity.body_shape: Single rooted mushroom body with thick stalk and cap, no arms or legs.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No limbs; the entire body remains rooted and mushroom-shaped.
visual_identity.surface: Smooth cap with sparse spots or folds and simple gill lines underneath.

scene_identity.natural_posture: Rigidly rooted with cap and stalk fully supported by ground or substrate.
behavior_style: reacting from a fixed fungal patch

accuracy_checks: opening reads as gill chamber not animal face

known_failure_modes.symptom: gill opening becomes animal mouth with eyes
known_failure_modes.correction: remove face and keep opening on underside of mushroom cap
restore rooted stalk and fixed base
